# Tallowmere Readout Agenda

Agenda for the readout of the [[tallowmere-ticketing-audit]] to [[marguerite-ostrowski|Marguerite Ostrowski]] and [[teo-barros|Teo Barros]] on 2026-10-30, 60 minutes at the theatre.

1. Ten minutes: what I tested and how, with the two patron sessions Teo recruited.
2. Twenty minutes: the three headline findings from [[tallowmere-seat-map-findings]]. The keyboard and screen reader failure on the seat map first, then seat size at default zoom, then the seat hold that expires without warning ([[wcag-timing-adjustable-docs]]).
3. Ten minutes: companion seats. Booking them only works by phone; the workaround the box office uses today is written up in [[tallowmere-companion-seat-workaround]].
4. Fifteen minutes: the fix list, sorted by who can fix it: the ticketing vendor, the theatre's web team, or the box office.
5. Five minutes: next steps and whether they want a retest after the vendor's fixes.

Bring printed copies of the fix list. Marguerite reads paper. Teo will want the box-office items first, so they are on page one.
